summary: Require upgrade-impact fragments before PRs merge

replay.detail: Python/Git CI validation introduces no daemon projection invalidation or replay trigger.

schema.detail: The PR validator changes no database schema or migrations.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules, digests and fleet sealing behavior are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No daemon, client or harness protocol changes; this is repository release-authoring validation.

downtime.detail: The hosted PR check runs without compilation and introduces no deployment interruption.

manual.detail: Every PR, including documentation-only changes, must add a fresh valid release-notes/NAME.json. The fast upgrade-impact job feeds the existing required linux-gate on PRs and merge groups. Existing fragments are immutable; corrections and later measurements use a new file. Publication still validates the entire interval since the last release. See docs/st3/release-impact.md in this source.

recovery.detail: No runtime recovery change. Authors fix a failed metadata check by adding or correcting their fresh fragment, then push the PR revision.
